description: Payoff, P&L, and breakeven price for a single-leg Deribit BTC/ETH option (long or short call/put) at a given scenario price at expiry. Deribit BTC/ETH options are coin-settled: premium, P&L, and the max profit/loss caps come back denominated in the base coin (BTC/ETH), not USD; a scenarioPnlUsd convenience field converts the coin P&L back to USD at the scenario price. Coin settlement means a long call's upside is capped (max profit = 1 − premium per unit, not unlimited) while a long put's upside is technically unbounded as price falls toward zero, the mirror image of a USD-settled option's payoff shape, not a bug. Edge cases: strike, premium, quantity and scenarioPrice above zero; a coin premium for a call must be below 1. Not covered: early exercise, margin, fees, Greeks, the probability of profit and the value before expiry; the result is the payoff at expiry at one scenario price. Use when user asks "what does my BTC call/put pay off at price X?" or "where's my breakeven on this option?". Returns: intrinsicPerUnitCoin, scenarioPnlCoin, scenarioPnlUsd, breakevenPrice, maxLossCoin/maxProfitCoin (null = unbounded), isProfitable. With exchange "binance" (USDT-settled, flat payoff, premiumUsdt instead of premiumCoin) it returns the USDT equivalents: intrinsicPerUnitUsdt, scenarioPnlUsdt, breakevenPrice (K + premium for a call, K - premium for a put), maxLossUsdt/maxProfitUsdt (null = unbounded: a long call's profit is unlimited, a long put's best case is K - premium); USDT is not converted to USD.

currency.description: Underlying. Default BTC. XAU and XAG (gold, silver) only with exchange binance.

exchange.description: Venue whose settlement rules apply. "deribit" (default): BTC/ETH, coin-settled, premium in the base coin. "binance": BTC/ETH/XAU/XAG, USDT-settled, flat payoff max(0, S-K) per unit, premium in USDT (use the *Usdt premium fields); the result carries exchange and settlement fields.

premiumCoin.description: Deribit only. Premium paid/received per contract, in the base coin (matches Deribit's own quoted price, e.g. 0.02 BTC); must be < 1 for a call

premiumUsdt.description: Binance only. Premium paid/received per unit, in USDT (e.g. 1500); must be < strike for a put

quantity.description: Number of contracts (Deribit BTC/ETH options have contract_size 1.0, so this is coin-denominated size)

scenarioPrice.description: Underlying price in USD to evaluate the payoff at
